name: Grout
summary: Connects a Linux retro handheld to a RomM server.

notes: Experimental TrimUI Smart Pro test package; upstream names this device but no minimum Knulli version or linked test report is claimed.
Do not use Grout's built-in updater during this test. It cannot be disabled through a supported setting; use Knulli App Store for repair or future updates.
The manager preserves and backs up pre-existing config.json, save_slots.json, cache, logs, and unknown files before adoption.

evidence.note: Version-pinned Knulli ZIP; 24,279,213 bytes compressed, 95,180,746 bytes extracted, SHA-256 1af9924fc42dd7213c45f09c1a8d93726c7ade5cdac8394a020a433260cbb356.
MIT license reviewed at the tagged commit.
Upstream lists TrimUI Smart Pro as tested with Knulli, without a firmware version or test report.

Reviewed paths are /userdata/roms/tools/Grout, /userdata/roms/tools/.update, /userdata/roms/tools/gamelist.xml, /userdata/roms, /userdata/bios, and /userdata/saves. Network access is required for RomM and updates. The launcher executes local files; the binary updater checks a supplied SHA-256 before staging release code.

install.warning: Unverified. Do not use Grout updater. Update only through Knulli App Store.
